variants.prompt: In a moody, blue-lit nightclub, a young woman with fiery red hair and bright green eyes, clad in a sheer, black lace corset that accentuates her curves, looks up at the camera with an intense, dominant gaze, her full lips parted in a slight, provocative smile, the neon lights of the dance floor reflected in her eyes as the DSLR camera frames her in a tight medium shot from behind, looking over her shoulder to capture her powerful, seductive presence.
